audit_status.source_base: Greek Hebrews text tradition; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for brotherly love, hospitality, prisoners, marriage, money, leaders, outside camp, sacrifice of praise, final blessing.

verses.restored: Let sibling-love remain.

familiar.text: Let brotherly love continue.

modern.text: Continue in brotherly love.

original.text: Ἡ φιλαδελφία μενέτω.

verses.restored: Do not forget hospitality, for through this some unknowingly hosted messengers.

familiar.text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

modern.text: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

original.text: τῆς φιλοξενίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, διὰ ταύτης γὰρ ἔλαθόν τινες ξενίσαντες ἀγγέλους.

verses.restored: Remember prisoners as bound with them, and those mistreated, since you yourselves also are in body.

familiar.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

modern.text: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.

original.text: μιμνῄσκεσθε τῶν δεσμίων ὡς συνδεδεμένοι, τῶν κακουχουμένων ὡς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὄντες ἐν σώματι.

verses.restored: Let marriage be honored among all, and the bed undefiled; for sexually immoral/misusing and adulterers the Divine will judge.

familiar.text: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

modern.text: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers. Christ’s Unchanging Nature

original.text: τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος, πόρνους ⸀γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: Let your way be without love of silver/money, being content with present things; for he has said: I will never leave you nor forsake you.

familiar.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

modern.text: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

original.text: ἀφιλάργυρος ὁ τρόπος· ἀρκούμενοι τοῖς παροῦσιν· αὐτὸς γὰρ εἴρηκεν· Οὐ μή σε ἀνῶ οὐδʼ οὐ μή σε ⸀ἐγκαταλίπω·

verses.restored: So we say with boldness: Lord is my helper; I will not fear. What will a human do to me?

familiar.text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

modern.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”

original.text: ὥστε θαρροῦντας ἡμᾶς λέγειν· Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, ⸀οὐ φοβηθήσομαι· τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος;

verses.restored: Remember your leaders, who spoke to you the word of the Divine; considering the outcome of their way, imitate the trust.

familiar.text: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

modern.text: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

original.text: Μνημονεύετε τῶν ἡγουμένων ὑμῶν, οἵτινες ἐλάλησαν ὑμῖν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ὧν ἀναθεωροῦντες τὴν ἔκβασιν τῆς ἀναστροφῆς μιμεῖσθε τὴν πίστιν.

verses.restored: Jesus Messiah yesterday and today, the same also into the ages.

familiar.text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

modern.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

original.text: Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐχθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτός, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας.

verses.restored: Do not be carried away by various and strange teachings; for it is beautiful/good for heart to be confirmed by grace, not foods, by which those walking were not benefited.

familiar.text: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

modern.text: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

original.text: διδαχαῖς ποικίλαις καὶ ξέναις μὴ παραφέρεσθε· καλὸν γὰρ χάριτι βεβαιοῦσθαι τὴν καρδίαν, οὐ βρώμασιν, ἐν οἷς οὐκ ὠφελήθησαν οἱ ⸀περιπατοῦντες.

verses.restored: We have an altar from which those serving the tent have no authority to eat.

familiar.text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

modern.text: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

original.text: ἔχομεν θυσιαστήριον ἐξ οὗ φαγεῖν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἐξουσίαν οἱ τῇ σκηνῇ λατρεύοντες.

verses.restored: For bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the holy places by the high priest concerning sin/misalignment are burned outside the camp.

familiar.text: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

modern.text: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.

original.text: ὧν γὰρ εἰσφέρεται ζῴων τὸ αἷμα περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰς τὰ ἅγια διὰ τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, τούτων τὰ σώματα κατακαίεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς·

verses.restored: Therefore Jesus also, so that he might sanctify the people through his own blood/life, suffered outside the gate.

familiar.text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

modern.text: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.

original.text: διὸ καὶ Ἰησοῦς, ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ διὰ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος τὸν λαόν, ἔξω τῆς πύλης ἔπαθεν.

verses.restored: So then let us go out to him outside the camp, bearing his reproach.

familiar.text: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

modern.text: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.

original.text: τοίνυν ἐξερχώμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ φέροντες.

verses.restored: For here we do not have a remaining city, but we seek the one coming.

familiar.text: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

modern.text: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come. Sacrifice, Obedience, and Prayer

original.text: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ὧδε μένουσαν πόλιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν μέλλουσαν ἐπιζητοῦμεν·

verses.restored: Through him, therefore, let us continually offer sacrifice of praise to the Divine, that is, fruit of lips confessing his name.

familiar.text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

modern.text: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.

original.text: διʼ αὐτοῦ ⸀οὖν ἀναφέρωμεν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως διὰ παντὸς τῷ θεῷ, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν καρπὸν χειλέων ὁμολογούντων τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: But do not forget doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices the Divine is pleased.

familiar.text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

modern.text: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

original.text: τῆς δὲ εὐποιΐας καὶ κοινωνίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, τοιαύταις γὰρ θυσίαις εὐαρεστεῖται ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: Trust your leaders and yield, for they keep watch over your souls/lives as those who will give account, so that they may do this with joy and not groaning, for this would be unprofitable for you.

familiar.text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

modern.text: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.

original.text: Πείθεσθε τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπείκετε, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀγρυπνοῦσιν ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ὡς λόγον ἀποδώσοντες, ἵνα μετὰ χαρᾶς τοῦτο ποιῶσιν καὶ μὴ στενάζοντες, ἀλυσιτελὲς γὰρ ὑμῖν τοῦτο.

verses.restored: Pray concerning us, for we are persuaded that we have a beautiful/good conscience, desiring to conduct ourselves beautifully in all things.

familiar.text: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

modern.text: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

original.text: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν, ⸀πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν, ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι.

verses.restored: And more abundantly I appeal to do this, so that I may be restored to you sooner.

familiar.text: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

modern.text: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon. Benediction and Farewell

original.text: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: Now the Divine of peace, the One leading up from dead ones the great Shepherd of the sheep, in blood/life of age-long covenant, our Lord Jesus,

familiar.text: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

modern.text: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

original.text: Ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου, τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,

verses.restored: may he equip you in every beautiful/good thing to do his will, doing in us what is pleasing before him through Jesus Messiah, to whom be glory into the ages of the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

modern.text: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

original.text: καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν ⸀παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐν ⸀ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς ⸀αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.

verses.restored: But I appeal to you, siblings, bear with the word of encouragement, for indeed I wrote to you briefly.

familiar.text: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

modern.text: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.

original.text: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως, καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: Know that our sibling Timothy has been released, with whom, if he comes soon, I will see you.

familiar.text: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

modern.text: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

original.text: γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ⸀ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον, μεθʼ οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: Greet all your leaders and all the holy ones. Those from Italy greet you.

familiar.text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

modern.text: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.

original.text: ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας.

verses.restored: Grace be with all of you.

familiar.text: Grace be with you all. Amen.

modern.text: Grace be with all of you.

original.text: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ⸀ὑμῶν.

translation_notes: Hospitality and prisoner-solidarity are embodied ethics: remember them as bound with them, since you are in body.
Leadership yielding is accountable and mutual; leaders give account and may not dominate.
Outside the camp is solidarity with reproach and exclusion, not contempt for Israel's camp imagery.
safety_note: Hebrews 13:17 must not be used for authoritarian control. Leaders are accountable watchers, and the whole chapter frames ethics through sibling-love, hospitality, prisoner solidarity, doing good, sharing, and grace.
